title: Normalized conormal cohomology of an arbitrary quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, I an ideal, B=R/I, and C a recorded standard cotangent-resolution coherence [def-trf-cotangent-resolution-data]. In the ordinary module derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let K be its standard differential complex for R\to B. There is an isomorphism H⁻¹(K)≅I/I². For each a∈I the standard relation vector 1\otimes d([C(a)]−[0]) is a cycle, and its homology class maps to a mod I² under this isomorphism. No regularity or finiteness is assumed.

proof.text: Present B by R itself over R. This is a polynomial presentation on the empty set. Its relative differentials vanish, and its conormal is canonically I/I², since ker(R→R/I)=I. The two-term naive complex therefore has H⁻¹ equal to I/I².

Apply the naive cotangent comparison to this presentation. Its good truncation comparison is an isomorphism, and good truncation preserves H⁻¹. Consequently the actual standard differential complex has the asserted H⁻¹ isomorphism.

Compute the two faces of [C(a)]−[0] using the recorded standard face equations: the first is the base constant a, the second is zero because a∈I. Their relative differentials vanish, so the alternating differential of the relation vector is zero. The explicit degree −1 naive projection formula sends it to the kernel class of the difference of those faces, namely a mod I². Homology naturality gives the asserted normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem quotient_conormal_homology
    [∀ B : CommRingCat.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (C : Coherence.{u}) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) :
    let q := Arrow.mk (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
    let K := differentialComplex (C.differentials (C.standard q))
    ∃ h : K.homology (-1) ≅ ModuleCat.of (R ⧸ I) I.Cotangent,
      ∀ a : I, ∃ z : K.cycles (-1),
        K.iCycles (-1) z =
          complexGenerator (C.differentials (C.standard q)) 1 1
            (_root_.cast (congrArg (fun T : CommRingCat.{u} ↦ (T : Type u))
              ((C.standard_spec q).1 1).symm)
              (MvPolynomial.X (MvPolynomial.C (a : R)) -
                MvPolynomial.X (MvPolynomial.C (0 : R)))) ∧
        h.hom (K.homologyπ (-1) z) = I.toCotangent a
